blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Thousands gathered here since Friday as the annual MassKara Festival‘s key highlights unfold this weekend. Revelers wearing smiling masks hit the streets on Saturday to witness contingents from schools and barangays trying tooutdo each other in the street dancing and other competitions. On Friday evening, Barangay Tangub claimed the championship in the Electric MassKara 2026, as six barangay contingents brought their festival identities, cultural stories, and community pride to the streets. The Electric MassKara and Mega Float Parade snaked from Megaworld The Upper East to the Bacolod City Government Center, featuring illuminated floats and performances that highlighted the […]...
